name: Turn Around Tassie 2020
information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) Please take the time to read the FAQ tab, even if you have previously competed. To ensure this is a COVID-safe environment, things will be done differently and there will be additional conditions in place. Please note there is strict density limit at the hall and there is a limit of ONE guest per competitor. **If you feel sick, stay at home.** If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will **not** be permitted in the venue. We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
